title: Hitting head at age 8 leads to lifetime of visits to heaven and spirit work
content:
I died when I was a boy of 8, when I fell and hit my head on an end table next to my bed. I saw a being in a burgundy robe and then I fell asleep, but I never forgot him.

Years went by when I would understand spirits and felt them. I would speak with them in my mind through telepathy, mostly to assist in their ascension to go home (heaven).

In 1999, I left my body completely and stood next to Jesus on the Mount of Olives where I found out I was the apostle Thomas. Seeing him bleeding with thorns on his head, I blamed myself and started searching for meaning in this vision.

I later met with many psychics and others who have helped me understand that I have been here since the beginning of time and space, and that I came from the star SIrius to assist in the ascension of this planet. Each night I go off to astral planes and timelines to clear issues, perform reincarnation of people who havent died yet...no joke, and go into " purgarory and hell" to raise souls back to heaven. Purgatory and hell don't exist, but we create them.

I have a humbling and profound gift that I believe we all have. Just want to share it with everyone. Many stories, even meeting the lost souls of Chernobyl.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: In 1999, the experiencer reports leaving the body completely and standing next to Jesus on the Mount of Olives.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus (standing next to Jesus on the Mount of Olives).
arrival.other_being_detail: A 'being in a burgundy robe' seen when age 8 after hitting head; also references 'spirits' encountered/assisted.

environment.environment_other_detail: Mentions astral planes and timelines; also mentions going into 'purgatory and hell' (stated as created, not real).

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: States assisting spirits' ascension to go home (heaven), clearing issues on astral planes/timelines, raising souls back to heaven; claims coming from Sirius to assist in the ascension of the planet.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell and hit head on an end table next to bed at age 8.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Initial childhood event includes seeing a being in a burgundy robe; later ongoing spirit/astral work, and a 1999 OBE-like vision with Jesus; past-life identity as apostle Thomas; star-origin claim (Sirius).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Narrative describes an initial childhood death/vision, followed by years of ongoing spirit communication and later a separate 1999 episode of leaving the body and being with Jesus; not a single linear NDE sequence.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Reports repeated nightly astral travel/visits to astral planes and timelines.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Claims star-origin from Sirius; identifies as apostle Thomas; reports nightly astral travel to clear timelines, perform reincarnation for people not yet dead, and enter 'purgatory and hell' to raise souls; mentions meeting lost souls of Chernobyl; states purgatory and hell are created and do not exist objectively.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I left my body completely and stood next to Jesus on the Mount of Olives where I found out I was the apostle Thomas.”
